concept: Werkform – fiktive Website für Metallverarbeitung und Konstruktion

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wide website hero image for a fictional German metal fabrication company
Primary request: a modern medium-sized metalworking production hall focused on precision sheet-metal fabrication
Scene/backdrop: clean real industrial workshop with one unbranded CNC laser cutting machine and press brake visible, organized work area, raw sheet stock and a few finished bent components
Subject: the production environment and precise machinery, no workers
Style/medium: photorealistic editorial industrial photography, credible and natural rather than glossy advertising CGI
Composition/framing: wide landscape view from slightly below eye level, strong architectural lines, clear foreground-to-background depth, suitable for a 3:2 website crop
Lighting/mood: cool daylight from high workshop windows mixed with restrained warm task lighting, calm, capable, precise
Color palette: graphite, steel gray, off-white, small restrained safety-orange accents
Materials/textures: brushed steel, galvanized sheet metal, matte machine housings, concrete floor with realistic light wear
Constraints: physically plausible German workshop, no readable text, no logos, no trademarks, no people, no watermarks
Avoid: excessive sparks, dramatic smoke, futuristic factory, spotless CGI render, unsafe clutter, impossible machinery

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: website section image showing manufacturing precision
Primary request: close editorial photograph of several precisely bent stainless-steel and blackened-steel components arranged for dimensional inspection on a heavy workshop table
Scene/backdrop: real metalworking inspection bench with a metal caliper and technical gauge present but no readable measurements
Subject: crisp bends, drilled holes, clean edges and varied surface finishes of the fabricated components
Style/medium: photorealistic industrial detail photography
Composition/framing: landscape close-up at a shallow three-quarter angle, layered components lead through the frame, suitable for a 4:3 crop
Lighting/mood: directional window light with controlled highlights, quiet and exact
Color palette: stainless steel, dark graphite, warm neutral workbench, one subtle orange fixture
Materials/textures: brushed metal grain, blackened steel, slight authentic tool marks, solid worn workbench
Constraints: realistic fabrication tolerances and geometry, no readable text, no logos, no trademarks, no people, no watermarks
Avoid: jewelry-like polish, random tools, dirty scrap yard, impossible parts, fake UI

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: website project image for a fictional metal construction case study
Primary request: a completed custom dark-steel staircase and balustrade installed inside a contemporary light-industrial office building
Scene/backdrop: restrained concrete and timber interior with daylight, practical commercial architecture
Subject: straight-run steel staircase with finely detailed handrail, clean junctions, believable fixings and precise fabrication
Style/medium: photorealistic architectural editorial photography
Composition/framing: wide landscape three-quarter view showing the full staircase and how it meets floor and upper landing, suitable for a 3:2 crop
Lighting/mood: natural side light, calm, durable, technically refined
Color palette: anthracite steel, pale concrete, warm oak, off-white
Materials/textures: powder-coated steel, concrete, oak, subtle realistic wear
Constraints: structurally plausible, current German commercial-building aesthetic, no readable signage, no logos, no trademarks, no people, no watermarks
Avoid: luxury mansion styling, decorative wrought iron, impossible floating structure, CGI look, dramatic color grading
